candidates.snippet: Five drones crossed into Moldovan airspace this morning, triggering explosions and leaving wreckage across several districts, according to the country's Defense Ministry. https://t.co/dhObVbTwYZ https://t.co/nhGViBtvSg
Warriors of Ukraine's 44th Artillery Brigade destroyed four Russian artillery pieces, including three Msta-B howitzers and one Giatsint-B howitzer. https://t.co/tN99NGjjyN

Overnight, a massive strike hit the Tsymbulova UAV launch base in Oryol Oblast, Russia. NASA FIRMS satellite data confirms multiple fire hotspots around the drone storage and launch facilities. https://t.co/n39xDE1SOV
